display_long_description:
Pour. Sort. Mix. Serve. Master the Bar.
Start by sorting colorful liquids into the correct bottles. Grab, tilt, and pour each bottle to organize the colors and solve increasingly challenging puzzles. Plan your moves carefully — every pour can make the difference!
[media]

Once your bottles are sorted, the real bartending begins. Check what your customer wants, prepare their drink by mixing the correct liquids, and follow the recipe carefully.

But a great drink needs the perfect finishing touch. Add the garnish your customer requested, complete the drink, and serve it exactly as ordered.

Play naturally with hand tracking or use VR controllers. Reach out, grab bottles, pour liquids, prepare drinks, and add garnishes using intuitive VR interactions.

🍹 Sort colorful liquids
🧩 Solve challenging puzzles
🥃 Mix customer orders
🍋 Add the requested garnish
🖐️ Play with hand tracking or controllers
🎯 Complete every order perfectly

Think before you pour. Follow the recipe. Add the finishing touch.
